referenceSyntaxHelper:
$ — read from the HTTP response JSON
$ is the whole response; $.field descends with dots.
E.g. $.data, $.balance_infos[0].total_balance, $.rate_limit.used_percent

Use $ in response root and quota windows (used / total / remaining / resetsAt).

Braces — fill dynamic values into the request (not from the response)
Put a variable name inside braces; it is replaced when the request is sent.
• accessToken — access token
• accountId — account id
• jwt.sub — JWT sub

Used in headers, cookies, and credential templates. Values come from cli:… login.
